description: The impossibility of making a database write and a broker publish atomic with an ordinary transaction.
A table in the business database where each event is stored in the same transaction as the data change.
A component that reads pending outbox rows, publishes them and marks them published.
A scheduled relay that periodically queries the unpublished rows.
A technique that reads the database log to publish outbox rows without polling.
A locking option that lets several relay instances take different rows without waiting for each other.
